requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model named InsufficiencyResponse for scoring insufficiency outputs.
The system must include a field valid_measure_count of type integer in the InsufficiencyResponse model.
The system must include a field required_minimum with a default value of 3 in the InsufficiencyResponse model.
The system must include a field missing_measure_types as a list of strings in the InsufficiencyResponse model.
The system must include a field message of type string for user-facing explanation in the InsufficiencyResponse model.
The system must enforce that valid_measure_count cannot be negative.
The system must enforce that required_minimum is an integer greater than or equal to 1.
The system must ensure the InsufficiencyResponse model is serializable to JSON without transformation.
The system must ensure field names and types are identical for both provider and clinical trial scoring outputs.
The system must validate that missing_measure_types contains only predefined measure category identifiers when provided.
The system must allow missing_measure_types to be an empty list when no classification of missing measures is available.
The system must require the message field to be non-empty.
The system must raise a validation error if any required field is missing during model instantiation.
The system must raise a validation error if valid_measure_count exceeds required_minimum by an unrealistic threshold greater than total possible measures (exception path).
The system must raise a validation error if missing_measure_types contains null or non-string values (exception path).
